description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Memory' which implements a cache decorator storing all cache retrievals in PHP's memory. It is primarily used for unit testing or scenarios with many configuration objects, extending the base cache decorator class and overriding cache management methods.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Memory
classes.description: A cache decorator class that stores definitions in PHP's memory for quick retrieval, mainly used in testing or configurations involving many objects.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the Memory cache decorator.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache and internal memory, calling the parent add method and storing the definition if successful.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a definition in the cache and internal memory, calling the parent set method and storing the definition if successful.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a definition in the cache and internal memory, calling the parent replace method and updating the stored definition if successful.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a definition from internal memory if available; otherwise, fetches from parent cache, stores it internally, and returns it.
